text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGER — authz.hiveprobe detected spike: 4.8k 401s in 3m, error rate +380%. Alerts: suspicious token reuse pattern. Incident-UI: https://redwood.inc/incident/5102030405
alice: Acked, I'm on-call. Triage starting. Anyone with recent deploys?
ben: No deploys from infra, looks like unusual traffic from a small set of IPs (68.45.12.0/24). Investigating logs. Pulling sample.
ben: `kubectl logs -n authsvc auth-0 --since=10m | grep "bearer" | head -n 50`
ben: ```
2026-03-18T12:02:11Z INFO auth "token=eyJ...snip" user=alice@example.com
2026-03-18T12:02:12Z WARN auth "invalid token signature" ip=68.45.12.13
2026-03-18T12:02:13Z INFO auth "token=eyJ...snip" user=bob@cust.com
```
carol: Security here. That pattern looks like token reuse. Do we see tokens in logs being forwarded externally? Check logshipper and s3 buckets.
ben: S3 forwarder shows recent put to s3://staging-logs/external/2026/03/18/auth.log.gz by service acct `log-forwarder@redwood-prod`. Listing now.
ben: `aws s3 ls s3://staging-logs/external/2026/03/18/`
ben: ```
2026-03-18 12:05  8.4MB auth.log.gz
```
ben: Downloaded and inspected — contains full auth headers, several bearer tokens and email addresses. That's a PII/leak path.
carol: Treat as security incident. Scope: staging bucket only? Any production copies?
ben: Searching; found matching logs in an external indexer endpoint called hiveprobe-logs (third-party). URLs in forwarder config point to `https://logs.hiveprobe.net/ingest/xyz`
alice: Oof. That explains external auth attempts. Likely someone scraped tokens from that indexer.
dave: Assigning immediate actions: 1) Rotate all tokens for service accounts used by log forwarder. 2) Disable forwarder to hiveprobe. 3) Revoke any leaked session tokens for users present. 4) Customer impact comms if prod tokens affected.
carol: I will own customer impact assessment and legal notification if scope expands. @alice coordinate key rotation with infra.
alice: On it. Rotating keys now: running `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create` and will push new creds to forwarder after we confirm destination is safe.
alice: `kubectl -n infra set env deployment/log-forwarder HIVEPROBE_KEY=REDACTED` — paused before apply.
ben: Also enabling a temporary WAF rule to block 68.45.12.0/24 and rate-limit auth endpoints.
ben: `wafctl block ip 68.45.12.0/24 --reason "suspicious auth probes"`
carol: Collecting list of affected users from logs and matching to customer tenants. Early check: contains internal dev emails and 2 customer emails (acme@cust.com, beta@client.io).
carol: Could be low scope but any customer token exposure requires notice. I'm starting draft comms.
alice: Key rotation in progress for service account `log-forwarder@redwood-prod` — creating new key and disabling old one. ETA 15m.
pagerbot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0318-01. Paging on-call sec-team.
carol: Can someone run `s3api get-bucket-acl` and check public flags? We need to ensure no public access.
ben: Confirmed bucket had block-public-access disabled on that prefix — fixing now: `aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket staging-logs --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true`
alice: After rotation, we'll reconfigure forwarder to redact auth headers and only send structured metrics. Not pushing to hiveprobe.
dave: Customer impact assessment: until we confirm prod tokens are not in the forwarder, treat as limited to staging and a handful of users. No broad service degradation expected. Keep customers posted if scope grows.
carol: Legal/Privacy looped in. I uploaded artifacts to secure case folder. Link: https://redwood.sec/cases/INC-2026-0318-01
ben: Running live scrub on S3: aws s3 rm s3://staging-logs/external/2026/03/18/auth.log.gz
ben: Done. Confirm deletion and replication. Also create retention hold to prevent re-ingest while we fix config.
alice: Keys rotated, old key disabled. Forwarder stopped. Will not redeploy until redaction verified.
carol: Confirmed no direct production buckets with same forwarder config. Risk to prod looks low. Still notify affected customers list tomorrow morning.
dave: Thanks team. Handing off to sec on-call for follow-ups. Oncall transfer: alice -> carol. @pagerbot please escalate to sec-pager in 30m unless incident closed.
alice: Good catch everyone. :thumbsup: 
pagerbot: Noted. Next escalation at +30m to #sec-pager if not resolved.
carol: I'll continue post-mortem draft and include KMS rotation steps. Closing live mitigation channel in 1h unless new evidence.
